strings.name: Dmitry Muratov
strings.summary: Muratov co-founded Novaya Gazeta in 1993 and defended investigative reporting through censorship and colleagues’ murders. He shared the 2021 peace Nobel with Maria Ressa. After wartime publication suspension, authorities labeled him a “foreign agent” in 2023 and he stepped down as editor. Remaining active in Russia, he attended the Moscow office’s closure in November 2026.
